notes: True homograph of the existing H7703 ("devastate"), both spelled שדד -- added as שדד¹ (lower Strong's number) per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H7703 is retroactively renamed שדד² in this same batch.
Piel's yiqtol 3ms slot is attested identically (same "harrow" sense) in Hos.10.11, Isa.28.24, and Job.39.10; Hos.10.11 kept as citation per the usual duplicate-slot tie-break.
